remarks: Amazing - 1340 square feet - Space Awaits in this modern, newer & pet friendly townhome. Welcome to Greenfield! Come see this end-unit townhome and visualize everyone in the family enjoying their own space. Located on the brim of Greenwich & close to downtown Stamford, living is easy here - bright and warm with an abundance of windows and sunshine! Contemporary kitchen features stunning granite countertops, rich cabinetry, stainless appliances and opens to the large living/dining area, there is a private washer/dryer upstairs, private entrance & parking for 2-cars. You'll also reap the economic benefits of green-built certification construction, natural gas heat, tankless hot water, central air AND NO ADDITIONAL FEES. Pets are permitted in Greenfield. 2 dogs  35lbs., 1 dog 60 lbs., 2 cats or 1 dog and 1 cat are allowed. Aggressive breeds are not permitted. Greenfield is a no smoking community.  Interested applicants please submit Greenfield Application found in supplements and credit check through applyconnect ONLY.
